summary: A cleaned, downloadable CSV of all Medicare-certified home health agencies sourced from CMS data.cms.gov — a fully public, no-auth dataset updated monthly. CMS publishes ~11,400 agency records including agency name, address, phone, CMS certification number, ownership type (for-profit/non-profit/government), and quality star ratings. CarePrecise charges $859–$4,795/year for a 9M+ provider database built from the same CMS sources; Ampliz charges $50/month. A one-time affordable CSV targeted at medical SaaS vendors who need exactly this vertical — not a massive multi-specialty database — undercuts every subscription by an order of magnitude.

audience.who: Medical SaaS vendors selling CRM, scheduling, EVV (electronic visit verification), billing, and payroll tools to home health agencies; medical equipment and supply reps (wound care, durable medical equipment); healthcare staffing agencies recruiting home health aides; and healthcare insurance brokers selling liability and workers comp to home health operators.

data_wanted: Agency name, doing-business-as name, CMS certification number, address (street, city, state, ZIP), phone number, ownership type (for-profit/non-profit/government), agency type (home health/hospice), Medicare participation status, overall quality star rating, date of most recent inspection — all sourced from CMS Provider Data Catalog (data.cms.gov), no authentication required.

evidence.source: CMS Provider Data Catalog — Home Health Care Agencies public dataset, no login required, CSV download available
evidence.quote: Home Health Care - National Data. Downloadable data file with information about home health agencies that participate in Medicare, including overall quality ratings.

willingness_to_pay.signal: CarePrecise's $859 single-download and $4,795/year subscription — built from the same CMS data — proves buyers pay hundreds to thousands of dollars for formatted healthcare provider lists. A one-time $49–$79 CSV of just home health agencies (not 9M records buyers don't need) is a no-brainer purchase for any medical SaaS SDR or equipment rep who needs to reach this specific vertical without paying for an enterprise data subscription.

first_sale_path.channel: Gumroad listing + Reddit r/homehealth, r/HealthIT, r/SaaS (for software vendors), LinkedIn outreach to medical SaaS SDRs and BDRs
first_sale_path.angle: "11,400 Medicare-Certified Home Health Agencies — US Database 2026, CSV" — ownership type, phone, address, quality star rating, ready to import into Salesforce or HubSpot. Positioned against CarePrecise's $859 database: 'You don't need 9 million provider records. You need 11,000 home health agencies. Here they are. One payment. Done.'
